INTRODUCTION
Purpose

This procedure is performed to determine the operability of IRM function of Reactor Protection System (RPS) Instrumentation, Control Rod Block Instrumentation, and Surveillance Instrumentation in the Neutron Monitoring System (NMS).
Scope

This procedure is performed on IRM Channel A. Surveillance Requirements (SR) 2SR3.3.1.1.9(IRM B), 2SR3.3.1.1.9(IRM C), 2SR3.3.1.1.9(IRM D), 2SR3.3.1.1.9(IRM E), 2SR3.3.1.1.9(IRM F), 2SR3.3.1.1.9(IRM G), and 2SR3.3.1.1.9(IRM H) must also be performed to satisfy Technical Specification SR 3.3.1.1.9 and Technical Requirements Manual (TRM) Technical Surveillance Requirements (TSR) 3.3.4.6 and 3.3.5.8 for IRM Channel calibration.

When this procedure is performed with the Reactor Mode Switch NOT in RUN position this procedure also partially satisfies SR 3.3.1.1.3 and SR 3.3.1.1.4 and TSR 3.3.4.3 and TSR 3.3.4.4 relating to IRM Channel functional test and TSR 3.3.4.9 for Rod Block Logic functional test.  With the Reactor Mode Switch NOT in RUN position, 2SR3.3.1.1.3(IRMs) is performed to satisfy Technical Specification (TS) and TRM requirements for IRM Channel functional test.

This procedure also partially satisfies SR 3.10.3.1 and SR 3.10.4.1 relating to IRM Channel calibration and functional test.  This procedure in conjunction with those listed in Section 1.2A fully satisfies SR 3.10.3.1 and SR 3.10.4.1 relating to IRM Channel calibration and functional test.  SR 2SR3.3.1.1.3(IRMs) satisfies these requirements for IRM Channel functional test.
This procedure provides overlap testing for, and partially satisfies, requirements of SR 3.3.1.1.14 for RPS Instrumentation Logic System Functional Test.
INOP bypass function has been added to allow functional testing of RPS and Reactor Manual Control System (RMCS).

This procedure is NOT required to be performed when entering Mode 2 from Mode 1 until 12 hours after entering Mode 2.

Precautions

Limitations

Calibration and functional test is to be performed on one channel at a time. All trips are to be reset and channel returned to fully operable status before starting another channel, unless otherwise directed by Unit Senior Reactor Operator (Unit SRO).

Jumpers are installed if scram links have been removed, in order to test IRM logic.  These jumpers defeat noncoincidence Scram function of neutron monitoring system.  When jumpers are installed, refueling operations are to stop until completion of this procedure and removal of jumpers.

If any other IRM in RPS trip Channel A is INOP (or becomes INOP during performance of this procedure), entry into TS Conditions and Required Actions can be delayed for up to 6 hours provided associated function maintains RPS trip capability.  This procedure can exceed the 6 hour testing limit.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
Responses which fail to meet Acceptance Criteria (AC) constitute unsatisfactory surveillance procedure results and require immediate notification of Unit SRO.
The following AC are applicable in all mode switch positions:
When high voltage power supply is lowered to 90 Vdc (88 to 92 Vdc) the INOP indicating light on CHANNEL A IRM drawer ILLUMINATES. (TS/TRM)
Asfound DOWNSCALE, UPSCALE HIGH, and UPSCALE HIGH HIGH trip setpoints are within TS/TRM Allowable Values.
DOWNSCALE  Greater than or equal to 0.040
UPSCALE HIGH  Less than or equal to 0.864
UPSCALE HIGH HIGH  Less than or equal to 0.960
When an internal signal is applied to IRM front panel meter, the front panel meter responds with an indication of between 38 and 42 UNITS on the 125 UNITS scale. (TRM)
The following AC are only applicable when 2HS995A/S1, REACTOR MODE SWITCH is NOT in RUN.
When simulated DOWNSCALE condition is sensed by IRM, annunciator CONTROL ROD WITHDRAWAL BLOCK (2XA555A, window 7) alarms or contacts OPEN in rod block logic circuit. (TRM)
When simulated UPSCALE HIGH condition is sensed by IRM, annunciator CONTROL ROD WITHDRAWAL BLOCK (2XA555A, window 7) comes in ALARM or contacts open in rod block logic circuit.(TRM)
When simulated UPSCALE HIGH HIGH condition is sensed by IRM, SCRAM SOLENOID GROUP A LOGIC RESET indicating lights EXTINGUISH. (TS)
When IRM Mode switch is in a position other than OPERATE, an INOP condition is sensed by IRM and the following occurs:
SCRAM SOLENOID GROUP A LOGIC RESET indicating lights EXTINGUISH. (TS)
CONTROL ROD WITHDRAWAL BLOCK (2XA555A, window 7) alarms or contacts OPEN in rod block logic circuit. (TRM)
When IRM A detector is withdrawn until IN indicating light is EXTINGUISHED, CONTROL ROD WITHDRAWAL BLOCK (2XA555A, window 7) alarms or contacts OPEN in rod block logic circuit. (TRM)
